summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi 3-7 Year Treasury Bond ETF (CIEI) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the FTSE US Treasury 3-7 Years index. The fund provides exposure to intermediate-term US Treasury bonds with three to seven years remaining to maturity. CIEI was launched on Jun 4, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
